correctness.evidence: Fresh independent enumeration to 50,000,000 gave 3,001,134 primes and reproduced every entry of both committed residue-transition matrices. Recomputed uniform chi-square values are 155166.0486 and 47958.5868, with the stated diagonal suppression and extremal cells.

originality.evidence: The checked prior literature establishes the consecutive-prime residue-bias phenomenon but did not supply the exact x<=50,000,000 pair matrices and residual statistics. Novelty is restricted to this finite cutoff dataset.

scientific_value.evidence: The exact transition matrices are reusable, independently reproducible benchmark data for numerical study of a recognized prime-distribution phenomenon.

residual_risks: Originality is limited to the checked literature; obscure duplicate tables cannot be excluded.
The comparison to conjectural formulas is descriptive and is not an asymptotic proof.
decision: PASS on all three axes as a finite exact benchmark.
